settings.hero_title: Crafted with Love, Worn with Pride.
settings.hero_text: At Srivaya, we believe every woman deserves to shine — every single day.
settings.story_lead: Stunning jewellery should never come with a stunning price tag.
settings.story_body:
Srivaya was born in the heart of India, founded by people who deeply believe that every woman — regardless of her budget — deserves to feel beautiful, confident, and celebrated.

We saw a gap where quality jewellery was either too expensive or too hard to find online. So we changed that. What began as a small passion project has grown into a brand trusted by thousands of happy customers across India.

Every piece we curate is handpicked with love, care, and an eye for detail — because jewellery isn't just an accessory, it's an emotion.
settings.why_title: Designed for the way you live
settings.why_intro: Beautiful pieces, thoughtful service, and everyday elegance — without compromise.
settings.why_1_text: Every piece is carefully quality-checked before it reaches you.
settings.why_2_text: Designer looks without the designer price tag.
settings.why_3_text: We deliver to every corner of India, quickly and safely.
settings.why_4_text: Hassle-free return & exchange — shop with peace of mind.
settings.mission_quote: To make every woman feel like the most elegant version of herself — through jewellery that is beautiful, accessible, and made for real life.
settings.mission_body: We help you create memories — at weddings, celebrations, or just a regular Tuesday when you want to feel a little extra special.
settings.founder_quote: When I started Srivaya, I wanted every customer to feel the same excitement I feel when I discover a truly stunning piece of jewellery — affordable enough that you don't think twice, and beautiful enough that you never forget it. Thank you for being part of our journey.
settings.reassure_text: If you still have doubts about our jewellery quality, finish, or colour — message us on WhatsApp. We will hop on a quick call or meeting and clarify everything before you buy.
settings.cta_text: Explore our curated collection of jewellery made to shine with you.
settings.social_text: Follow along and tag us — we love seeing you shine.
